transcript.text: Hello sir mujhe ek cheez puchni thi... kya meri shaadi usi person se hogi ya nahi

Thik h krti hu main try ye

Ok thik h mai try krti hu
Sahi hai ji. Shaniwar ko karke dekhna, zaroor asar padega.
Thik hai ji thanks 🙏
Khush rahiye ji, sab thik hoga.
